name: Across the Void
source:
You're the new captain of a luxury space liner, and it's your job to make sure your passengers cross the galaxy safely -- in the middle of a galactic civil war! This romantic space opera is like nothing you've experienced!

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Across_the_Void]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你是豪华星际客轮的新任船长，职责是确保乘客安全穿越银河——而此时，银河内战正打得不可开交！这场浪漫的太空歌剧，将带给你前所未有的体验！

[摘自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Across_the_Void]Choices维基[/url]]
